title: VPD officer cleared of wrong-doing in fatal shooting
article: VANCOUVER (NEWS1130) - Mounties have cleared the Vancouver police officer who shot and killed a man near Broadway and Birch three years ago.
Police got a call about a domestic dispute. When they got to the home, a man had a knife to a woman's throat. Eugene Knight was then shot; he died at the scene.
The RCMP investigation has wrapped up and no charges will be laid. The Office of the Police Complaint Commission will now review the file.
